This event is open to specific members only. You need to
Sign In
Details
Join Yale’s Cultural Centers, the Afro-American Cultural Center, the Asian American Cultural Center, La Casa Cultural de Julia de Burgos: the Latine Cultural Center, the Middle Eastern and North African Cultural Community, and the Native American Cultural Center for a warm welcome to campus and an evening of community, conversation, and food! Connect with fellow students who, like you, are experiencing their first year at Yale. Get to know the Cultural Centers and the communities that are here to support and celebrate you throughout your time at Yale.
All new Yale College students, including first-year, transfer, and Eli Whitney students, are welcome. We’re excited to welcome you and we can’t wait to meet you!
Food will be served on a first-come, first-served basis.
